unsupported: Barnhardt Manufacturing Co. was founded in 1900 in Charlotte, North Carolina, and has operated continuously for over 125 years.

Through its NCFI brand, the company also manufactures high-performance polyurethane foam solutions, including spray foam insulation, foam roofing, agricultural and geotechnical foams, and OEM foam panels for coolers, refrigeration, taxidermy, and marine flotation.

Known for: Over 125 years of cotton purification expertise; Fast, reliable nationwide and global delivery of engineered fibers; Multiple cotton types: organic, traditional, and reclaimed; High-performance foam solutions since 1964; OEM foam solutions for coolers, refrigeration, and marine flotation
